data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $2.90 for fiscal 2023, compared with a diluted loss per share of $0.27 for fiscal 2022. Because fiscal 2022 was a loss, a conventional percentage change isn't meaningful. Dividing by a negative base gives a misleading figure of roughly negative 1,174 percent. The better description is a swing of $3.17 per share from a loss to a profit. The 2022 loss came mainly from a pre-tax valuation loss of about $12.7 billion on Amazon's investment in Rivian. Net income for fiscal 2023 was about $30.4 billion ($30,425 million), compared with a net loss of about $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022.
